components.name: Primary action
components.description: Blue action for the current task.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:40px;padding:7px 16px;border:1px solid var(--accent,#2459d3);border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent,#2459d3);color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms,border-color 160ms}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-hover,#1946b4);border-color:var(--accent-hover,#1946b4)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2459d3);outline-offset:4px}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.6}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:40px;padding:7px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e8f0);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#202b3d);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms,border-color 160ms}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--surface,#f5f7fb);border-color:#c5cfdf}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2459d3);outline-offset:4px}.ds-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.6}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Icon action
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="打开导航"><svg width="21" height="21" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"/></svg></button>

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Above-field label and compact native input.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-paper">试卷名称</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-paper" placeholder="输入试卷名称">
components.css: .ds-label{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink,#202b3d)}.ds-field{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;width:100%;min-height:38px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid #d4d4d8;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#202b3d);caret-color:var(--accent,#2459d3)}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#657084)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2459d3);outline-offset:4px}.ds-field:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.6}

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Current module in the white navigation rail.
components.html: 试卷管理
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:46px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft,#edf2ff);color:#2451bc;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 160ms,color 160ms}.ds-nav:hover{background:var(--accent-soft,#edf2ff);color:#2451bc}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2459d3);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav{transition:none}}

components.name: Status badges
components.description: Chinese labels and dots pair with semantic colors.
components.html: 处理中已完成需重试

components.name: Upload surface
components.description: White working surface and dashed native file target.
components.html:
添加试卷

PDF、JPG、PNG
components.css: .ds-upload-panel{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e8f0);border-radius:12px;padding:26px 28px;color:var(--ink,#202b3d)}.ds-upload-panel h2{margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:600}.ds-drop{position:relative;margin-top:22px;padding:28px 20px;background:#fbfcff;border:1px dashed #b9c8e4;border-radius:10px;min-height:160px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;text-align:center}.ds-drop svg{color:var(--accent,#2459d3);margin-bottom:6px}.ds-drop label{font-weight:500}.ds-drop>span{color:var(--muted,#657084);font-size:13px}.ds-drop input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-drop:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2459d3);outline-offset:3px}.ds-drop[data-dragging="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft,#edf2ff);border-color:var(--accent,#2459d3)}.ds-drop:has(input:disabled){opacity:.55}.ds-drop input:disabled{cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-upload-panel{padding:20px}.ds-drop{padding:24px 16px}}

components.name: Management table
components.description: Compact row hierarchy with local overflow.
components.html:
试卷名称状态操作
数学试卷已完成查看试卷
components.css: .ds-table-wrap{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e8f0);border-radius:12px;overflow-x:auto}.ds-table{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;text-align:left;color:var(--ink,#202b3d)}.ds-table th{background:#f9fafc;color:var(--muted,#657084);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;padding:12px 24px}.ds-table td{padding:18px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#e3e8f0);font-size:13px}.ds-table tbody tr:hover{background:#fcfdff}.ds-table a{color:var(--accent,#2459d3);text-decoration:none}.ds-table a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-table a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2459d3);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-table{min-width:680px}}

components.name: Content switch
components.description: Underlined switch between questions and standard answers.
components.css: .ds-tabs{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;display:flex;gap:24px;margin:26px 0 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e3e8f0)}.ds-tabs button{font:inherit;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;padding:12px 4px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#657084);font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--accent,#2459d3)}.ds-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--accent,#2459d3);border-bottom-color:var(--accent,#2459d3)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#2459d3);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Quiet waiting
components.description: Polite status with document motion and three dots, without progress stages.
components.html:
正在处理，请稍候

结果准备好后会自动显示。你可以离开页面，稍后回来查看。
components.css: .ds-wait{font-family:"Geist Variable", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "PingFang SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;min-height:290px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:38px 24px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink,#202b3d)}.ds-wait h2{margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:600}.ds-wait p{margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#657084);font-size:13px;max-width:50ch}.ds-animation{position:relative;color:var(--accent,#2459d3);width:64px;height:72px;display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-animation svg{width:40px;height:40px;animation:ds-document 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}.ds-animation span{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#2459d3);animation:ds-dot 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}.ds-animation span:nth-of-type(1){left:20px}.ds-animation span:nth-of-type(2){left:30px;animation-delay:.18s}.ds-animation span:nth-of-type(3){left:40px;animation-delay:.36s}@keyframes ds-document{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.75}50%{transform:translateY(-5px);opacity:1}}@keyframes ds-dot{0%,70%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.3}35%{transform:translateY(-4px);opacity:1}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-animation svg,.ds-animation span{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Oh My Paper uses the modern, concise OA/admin direction chosen by the user: a white navigation rail and header around a cool gray work area, with white bordered working surfaces and blue primary actions. Chinese system sans, compact tables and consistent fields make paper and grading tasks easy to scan.

The interface has three clearly named work areas: 试卷管理, 批改管理 and 快速批改. Content and actionable results carry the hierarchy. Ordinary users see completed work, calm waiting feedback and recovery actions; administrator execution evidence sits behind collapsed disclosures.
keyCharacteristics: Cool gray workspace, white navigation and content surfaces, restrained blue actions.
Desktop office layout with a persistent rail; phone navigation uses an accessible drawer.
Compact management tables and predictable form controls.
Readable question hierarchy and reports, with calm waiting and separate administrator evidence.
dos: Do use the cool gray workspace, white bordered surfaces and blue primary actions.
Do keep the three main Chinese navigation labels and one clear starting action per work area.
Do preserve question numbering, shared stems, subquestions, material images, mathematical content and unknown scores.
Do keep results, retries and quiet waiting feedback readable for ordinary users; keep execution evidence in collapsed administrator disclosures.
Do preserve keyboard focus, drawer focus management, local table/math scrolling and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't expose internal stages, saved drafts or technical exceptions to ordinary users.
Don't replace working paper content and tables with decorative metric cards.
Don't add a display font, decorative illustration or ornamental gradient to this office interface.
Don't claim progress percentages or stage completion through the waiting animation.
Don't reintroduce class, batch-student, practice or analytics navigation into the documented three-module scope.
